opening.argument: The video does more than display an isolated financial result. Its title instructs viewers on “How to join #Forsage BUSD,” while the displayed Forsage profile lists profits alongside “Partners, Team and Ratio” fields and a WhatsApp/call contact. The speaker then presents a claimed income amount—“See here mine made at 925 L”—and urges viewers to pursue similar income and contact the promoter: “so u also try to make such income SO CALL ME, MAIL ME.” Together, the joining instructions, recruitment-oriented metrics, income promotion, and direct solicitation support a tiered recruitment mechanism rather than an ordinary financial demonstration.
